t: The Laser Node is the most important block in LaserIO as it allows interaction with adjacent blocks. $(br2)By using Cards such as the $(l:laserio:card_item)Item Card$(/l), you can interact with the adjacent block to transfer Items, Fluids, Energy, or Redstone.
激光节点能与毗邻方块交互，是本模组中最为重要的方块。$(br2)诸如$(l:laserio:card_item)物品卡$(/l)的各式物流卡可以让节点传输物品、流体、能量或红石信号。

Each side of a node has a 3x3 grid of inventory slots that accept Cards. Right click a node's side to open it's UI. $(br2)Use the buttons along the top to change which side you're working on, in case the side you want to modify isn't easily accessible.$(br2)The adjacent screenshot shows a node interacting with an inventory on it's west side.
节点的每个侧面都有接受物流卡的 3x3 方格。右击节点侧面以打开其界面。$(br2)可以用界面上方的按钮切换活动面，以免想调整的面不方便右击。$(br2)下页截图中的节点正与其西侧箱子交互。
装有物流卡的节点界面
Nodes can interact with multiple adjacent inventories at the same time.
节点能同时与不同侧面的存储空间交互。
在两个箱子之间的节点

Nodes can be connected together using the $(l:laserio:laser_wrench)Laser Wrench$(/l), allowing connections between distant inventories.  The maximum range between connections is 8 blocks.$(br2)If your nodes are father apart, it is recommended to use $(l:laserio:laser_connector)Laser Connectors$().
节点可用$(l:laserio:laser_wrench)激光扳手$(/l)相互连接，从而连接相距较远的存储空间。节点间连接最大长度为 8 格。$(br2)若节点间距大于该距离，推荐选用$(l:laserio:laser_connector)激光连接器$()连接两者。
